concerns.text: FR-001 mandates a deterministic synthetic generator (seed=42) as the PRIMARY source. T007 is the only task creating this generator, yet it is marked unchecked. Without T007, T012 (ingest) and all downstream tasks have no data source, breaking the entire pipeline.

FR-001 requires ingesting the synthetic data. T012 is the orchestration task for this but is unchecked. It depends on T007 (generator) and T001-T003 (directories). Missing T012 means no validated dataset is produced for US1.

FR-002 requires engineering interaction features (cold_work * Mn, Mg, Si, Cu). T018 is the specific task for this but is unchecked. Without T018, the 'pinning effect' hypothesis (Constitution VI) cannot be tested in US2 or US3.

US2 requires saving the trained model (FR-004) and generating metrics. T027 (save model) and T028 (generate metrics) are unchecked. T034 (Permutation Test) and T036 (SHAP) depend on the model artifact from T027. Missing these blocks US3.

FR-005 and FR-006 require a Permutation Test and SHAP analysis. All implementation tasks for US3 (T032-T039) are unchecked. This leaves the core research question (statistical significance of interactions) unaddressed.

US3 requires unit tests for Permutation Test and SHAP logic. T030 and T031 are unchecked. While tests are optional per the header, the spec's 'Independent Test' for US3 explicitly requires running these tests to verify p-values and SHAP values. Missing these tasks risks unverified statistical logic.

The plan requires a 'quickstart.md' with a 5-step execution guide. T040 (update README/quickstart) and T046 (validate quickstart) are unchecked. Without these, the 'Independent Test' for the full pipeline cannot be executed by a user.

T045 contains a stale/contradictory instruction: 'do NOT fall back to synthetic' immediately followed by 'synthetic is already the primary source'. This contradicts FR-001 which states synthetic is primary and external is optional. The task description needs editing to align with the spec.
